products.name: CoCounsel (Casetext)
products.note: Legal research AI; litigation support; Westlaw integration; attorney work product risk

profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters is a publicly traded global content and technology company headquartered in Toronto, listed on both Nasdaq and TSX under the ticker TRI, with a CIK of 0001075124. The company describes itself as delivering purpose-built technology to help professionals make faster decisions and gain sharper insights across legal, tax, trade, risk, and government sectors. Its platform portfolio includes CoCounsel, an AI assistant for legal professionals grounded in Westlaw and Practical Law content, and ONESOURCE+, which the company describes as connecting tax, trade, legal, and risk workflows in an AI-powered approach. The site also notes the August 2026 launch of Thomson, the company's first proprietary large language model developed in-house, as well as the deployment of the next generation of CoCounsel Legal by global law firm Greenberg Traurig, LLP.

CoCounsel is positioned by Thomson Reuters as built on what the company calls Fiduciary-Grade AI principles, intended for professionals who require defensible work product across complex workflows including research, analysis, and drafting. The site highlights a case study in which a firm called Justly Prudent used CoCounsel and Westlaw AI to increase litigation capacity by 100%. Thomson Reuters also offers AI-powered Harmonized System code classification for trade compliance, marketed as fast, accurate, and audit ready. The company's held facts record CoCounsel, originally associated with Casetext, as its primary tracked AI product in the Finance and Legal AI category, with noted applications in legal research, litigation support, and Westlaw integration.
